name: Matsuri no Yoru no Yume
source:
Main heroine lost her parents early and was brought up in a neighbor family that had a boy in it. The fresh siblings grow up and one day go to a festival there. There is a bad premonition about the kappa monster on the pond lurking here, but heroes still make their way there...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角早年失去了父母，在邻居家被抚养长大，那家里有一个男孩。青梅竹马的两人一起长大，有一天去了那里的祭典。关于池塘里潜伏的河童怪物有不祥的预感，但主人公们还是前往了……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
